    "movie": 8, "movies": 8, "film": 8, "films": 8,
    "recommend": 6, "recommendation": 6, "recommendations": 6,

}

def fetch_note_summaries(search_query):
    records = []
    note_page_index = 0
    note_page_limit = 20
    while True:
        note_page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_access_token, query=search_query, dont_reorder_pinned=True, page_index=note_page_index, page_limit=note_page_limit)
        records.extend(note_page)
        if len(note_page) < note_page_limit:
            break
        note_page_index += 1
    return records
selected_request_words = set(tokenize(selected_request_message["message"]))
primary_note_query = "film" if ({"film", "films"} & selected_request_words and not ({"movie", "movies"} & selected_request_words)) else "movie"
note_summaries = fetch_note_summaries(primary_note_query)
if not note_summaries:
    note_summaries = fetch_note_summaries("")
print([{"note_id": row["note_id"], "title": row["title"], "tags": row["tags"], "updated_at": row["updated_at"], "pinned": row["pinned"]} for row in note_summaries])

def clean_list_line(value):
    cleaned = value.strip()
    while cleaned and cleaned[0] in "-*•":
        cleaned = cleaned[1:].strip()
    if cleaned.startswith("[ ]") or cleaned.lower().startswith("[x]"):
        cleaned = cleaned[3:].strip()
    digit_end = 0

    if digit_end and digit_end < len(cleaned) and cleaned[digit_end] in ".)-:":

    return cleaned
